data.name: FrFoldersSubtitle
data.value: Choose where to install StackR and where your web projects live.

data.name: FrChecksSubtitle
data.value: A few checks before installing anything. Nothing on your system is changed.

data.name: FrComponentsSubtitle
data.value: Recommended stable versions, downloaded from their official sources.

data.name: FrInstallSubtitle
data.value: Each component is downloaded over HTTPS and checked against its SHA-256 hash before extraction.

data.name: FrTerminalSubtitle
data.value: The php, mysql, composer, node and stackr commands in any terminal.

data.name: FrSummarySubtitle
data.value: Everything is ready. Review the summary, then finish.

data.name: FrSettingsResetMessage
data.value: The settings file was unreadable: a copy was kept (stackr.json.bak) and default values are suggested.

data.name: FrRootHint
data.value: Components, configuration, MySQL data and logs go here. Avoid Program Files: StackR never needs administrator rights.

data.name: FrWwwHint
data.value: Each subfolder automatically becomes a https://<name>.test site.

data.name: FrUseLaragonWwwHint
data.value: StackR only reads and serves this folder: your Laragon installation is never modified.

data.name: FrFoldersFootnote
data.value: Spaces and accented characters are allowed in paths.

data.name: FrFolderNotAbsolute
data.value: Enter a full path, for example C:\StackR.

data.name: FrFolderNetwork
data.value: Choose a folder on a local drive (not a network share).

data.name: FrFolderInvalidChars
data.value: This path contains characters Windows does not allow (< > : " ? *, or a trailing space or dot).

data.name: FrFolderDriveRoot
data.value: Choose a folder, not the root of a drive (for example C:\StackR).

data.name: FrFolderProtected
data.value: This folder is protected by Windows (Program Files or Windows) and would require administrator rights.

data.name: FrFolderLaragon
data.value: StackR never installs inside the Laragon folder, so that it is never modified.

data.name: FrFolderIsFile
data.value: This path points to an existing file, not a folder.

data.name: FrWwwIsRoot
data.value: The www folder cannot be the installation folder itself.

data.name: FrWwwContainsRoot
data.value: The www folder cannot contain the installation folder: everything would be published as a site.

data.name: FrWwwInternal
data.value: The www folder cannot be inside StackR's bin, etc, data, logs or tmp folders.

data.name: FrChecksAllGoodMessage
data.value: No conflict found: you can continue.

data.name: FrLaragonRunningMessage
data.value: Stop Laragon before starting StackR's services (ports 80/443/3306 in use). StackR will never close it for you.

data.name: FrVcMissingMessage
data.value: Apache and PHP need it to start. Install it from Microsoft's official website, then click "Check again".

data.name: FrPortsHint
data.value: StackR only listens on 127.0.0.1. A port in use only prevents the matching service from starting.

data.name: FrChecksFootnote
data.value: Nothing here is blocking: you can continue and fix these later.

data.value: Language of your sites (run by Apache)

data.name: FrCompMySql

data.name: FrCompMailpit
data.value: Catches the e-mails sent by your sites

data.name: FrVcWarningMessage

data.name: FrHttpsWhatTitle
data.value: A certificate authority unique to this computer

data.name: FrHttpsWhat
data.value: StackR creates its own certificate authority (CA). It is restricted to .test names and localhost: it cannot sign any other site.

data.name: FrHttpsWhy
data.value: For your browser to trust https://mysite.test, add it to the trusted certificates of your Windows account. Windows will ask you to confirm.

data.name: FrHttpsKey
data.value: Its private key is encrypted (DPAPI) and never leaves your account. No administrator rights are needed.

data.name: FrCaTrusted
data.value: The local CA is trusted by Windows

data.name: FrCaNotTrusted
data.value: The local CA is not trusted yet

data.name: FrCaConfirmHint
data.value: Click "Trust", then "Yes" in the Windows security window.

data.name: FrCaDeclinedMessage
data.value: You can continue: sites will work, but the browser will show an HTTPS warning. You can try again from Settings.
